what: Step 2 — Define a custom pack constructor
title: Add a New Rule Pack
text: pack constructor : accept configuration (domain, thresholds, ownership), create one new_flag_rule(...) objects, return plain list rules.
code: make_rule_pack_lab_custom <- function(domain = "LB",                                       owner_team = "Data Management",                                       hgb_min = 6,                                       hgb_max = 22) {   list(      # Rule 1: Hemoglobin plausibility window     new_flag_rule(       id = "LAB001_HGB_OUT_OF_RANGE",       domain = domain,       severity = "warning",       category = "clinical_review",       owner_team = owner_team,       fn = function(df) {         needed <- c("USUBJID", "LBTESTCD", "LBSTRESN")         if (!all(needed %in% names(df))) return(data.frame())          testcd <- as.character(df$LBTESTCD)         value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df$LBSTRESN))         bad <- testcd == "HGB" & !is.na(value) & (value < hgb_min | value > hgb_max)         if (!any(bad)) return(data.frame())          df[bad, c("USUBJID", "LBTESTCD", "LBSTRESN"), drop = FALSE]       }     ),      # Rule 2: Result unit should be present when result is present     new_flag_rule(       id = "LAB002_RESULT_WITHOUT_UNIT",       domain = domain,       severity = "error",       category = "data_entry",       owner_team = owner_team,       fn = function(df) {         needed <- c("USUBJID", "LBTESTCD", "LBORRES", "LBORRESU")         if (!all(needed %in% names(df))) return(data.frame())          result_present <- !is.na(df$LBORRES) & nzchar(as.character(df$LBORRES))         unit_missing <- is.na(df$LBORRESU) | !nzchar(as.character(df$LBORRESU))         bad <- result_present & unit_missing         if (!any(bad)) return(data.frame())          df[bad, c("USUBJID", "LBTESTCD", "LBORRES", "LBORRESU"), drop = FALSE]       }     ),      # Rule 3: Duplicate test on same date for same subject     new_flag_rule(       id = "LAB003_DUP_SUBJECT_TEST_DATE",       domain = domain,       severity = "warning",       category = "ops_anomaly",       owner_team = owner_team,       fn = function(df) {         needed <- c("USUBJID", "LBTESTCD", "LBDTC")         if (!all(needed %in% names(df))) return(data.frame())          keys <- df[, needed, drop = FALSE]         dup <- duplicated(keys) | duplicated(keys, fromLast = TRUE)         if (!any(dup)) return(data.frame())          df[dup, needed, drop = FALSE]       }     )   ) }
